test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

I was kept waiting for more than an hour to get an appointment by the staff.

options.text: The staff had kept me waiting for more than an hour to get an appointment.
The staff keep me waiting for more than an hour to get an appointment.
The staff kept me waiting for more than an hour to get an appointment.
The staff kept me wait for more than an hour to get an appointment.

solution:
The correct answer is** "The staff kept me waiting for more than an hour to get an appointment."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. It is in Simple Past Tense. As per the given question we have to change it into Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of Simple Past Tense is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• In the passive voice, the subject is** "I"** and the object is **"staff."**
 
• So, in the active voice, the subject would be** "staff" **and the object would be** "me." **
 
 
• 'Was kept' will be changed into 'kept.'
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.
